name: obsidian-hemingway
description: Hemingway-style readability highlights, live inside Obsidian notes.

scripts.test: esbuild test/analyzer.test.mts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=test/.out.mjs --log-level=error && node test/.out.mjs && esbuild test/proofread.test.mts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=test/.out2.mjs --log-level=error && node test/.out2.mjs && esbuild test/tokenizer.test.mts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=test/.out3.mjs --log-level=error && node test/.out3.mjs
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json

author: dhruvir-zala
